trace.question: Calculate the difference in view count from post posted by Mornington and view count from posts posted by Amos.
trace.evidence: calculation = SUBTRACT(SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Mornington'), SUM(ViewCount where DisplayName = 'Amos'));

attempts.sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')

trace.final_sql:
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN u.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN p.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos')
trace.answer: The difference in view count between Mornington's posts and Amos's posts is -497, meaning Amos's posts have 497 more views than Mornington's.
